document:216.text:
Most Honorable Lord Ravion,

Greetings! I'm a maid at the palace, but I doubt you'd know who I am... After all, there are so many people around, and I've never had the chance to speak with you. But I just wanted to say… I've always looked up to you! No, not just that! I think you're incredible, charming, and… honestly, really good-looking.

(Oh no, I don't know what I'm writing...)

Your Highness, you're a blessing from the Queen—of course, you're the Queen's son. I mean, you remind me of the moon in the night sky, shining gently from far above... Ugh, forget it, I'm really not great with words. The point is, I like you a lot!

I hope this letter won't be burned! I'd be so grateful if you could just take a quick look at it... Ugh...

(I'm not making any sense... Let me start over!)
document:216.source_cn:
尊敬的沙利叶殿下：

呃……您好！我是宫里的侍女……嗯，当然您肯定不认识我，宫里人那么多，我平时也没机会说话的。可是，可是！我一直都很敬仰您！不，不只是敬仰！是觉得您……呃，很厉害，很高贵，也……很好看。
（天啊，我在写什么……）

殿下！您就像女王的恩典，呃，不对，您本来就是女王之子……您就像夜晚的月亮，又温柔又高远！啊不，您其实比月亮还……呃……算了，总之，我很喜欢您！
希望这封信不要被烧掉！要是您能看看就好……呃……

（我究竟在写什么语无伦次的东西……我还是再写一封吧！）
